items.issue: The source attributes private motives, attraction and relationship hierarchy to identifiable public figures.
items.disposition: Attribute to Mikey and keep unverified; do not present as facts about the named people.

items.issue: Selected posts and short interview clips are treated as proof of hidden intent even though the full threads, dates, responses and edit context are incomplete.
items.disposition: Use the frames only to document what was displayed; require original posts and full context for factual interpretation.

items.issue: The video equates calmness, commanding language and partner deference with legitimate authority and attraction.
items.disposition: Do not convert hierarchy or silencing into relationship advice; retain only the narrow self-regulation theme.

items.issue: Claims that women submit to stronger people, attack weaker people and admire cognitive strength are broad unsupported gender generalizations.
items.disposition: Keep as Mikey's model only; do not generalize to women or an individual.

items.issue: Student testimonial screenshots are used near claims about course-related change, but authorship, consent, completeness and outcomes are not verified.
items.disposition: Treat as promotional self-report and do not use as effect evidence.

items.issue: The resource-to-problem-solving inference assigns causal credit to the director without production records or comparison.
items.disposition: Retain the abstract distinction; keep the named-case application speculative.

items.issue: ASR corrupts names, 'rapper', 'strong behavior signals' and several sentences.
